merged.title: Planet-named level dirs, readable symbol names (names.h), overlay regression fix
merged.author: Lynder063
merged.untrustedBody:
## Summary

- **Levels:** each `src/overlays/lNN/` directory is renamed to `lNN_<planet>/`. The mapping lives in one table, `tools/levels.py`, and `overlay_src.py` and `gen_progress_report.py` read it. Symbols and baserom paths keep the number.
- **Names:** a new `config/names.tsv` names 1027 symbols. The generated `include/names.h` provides 399 macros that map readable names onto the `func_`/`D_` address names. `tools/names.py apply` rewrote 961 uses inside function bodies. Definitions, declarations and stubs keep their address names, so no tool is affected.
- **Fix:** `func_L00_00265558` had regressed to 88/96 bytes in its file, which made `gen_progress_report.py --check` fail on `main`. Both it and `func_L00_002653A0` are now exact.
- **Tool fix:** `tools/lombyte.py map` crashed on `func_LNN_` names and would misalign on Lombyte's new overlay units.
- **Docs:** added `docs/NAMES.md` and an OVERLAYS.md "Levels" section. SIBLING_DECOMPS.md gains RC1, including the per-object compiler

merged.title: feat(overlays): 156 level-code matches, variant catalogue, queue-wave workflow
merged.author: Veradictus
merged.untrustedBody:
## Summary

156 more level functions matched (30,944 bytes), a catalogue that tells
apart functions differing only in a constant, and the agent workflow that
produced most of the matches, documented in full. Your main is merged in
(planet directories, `names.h`, the movie revert and the rule on sources).

## Matches

| Source | Functions |
|---|---|
| Sonnet queue workers, five waves | 84 |
| Cloned from matched functions with no model (`overlay_variants.py clone`) | 52 |
| A second agent, verified here | 20 |

Every function passes the strict overlay check in its landed file. One
worker match was rejected at review (it read an unassigned local).

## Progress

| | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| Functions | 1,621 / 4,987 | 1,777 / 5,111 |
| Code | 7.93% | 8.72% |
| Level code | 1.30% | 2.24% |
| Common level code | 2.68% | 3.58% |
| Level-specific code | 0.48% | 1.45% |
| Executable | 53.88% | 53.88% |

The function total grows by 124 because of the catalo
